PDF OCR Tool

Extract text from scanned PDFs with real OCR: pages are rendered and recognized in your browser, then shown with copy and download.

Starting…

Real OCR with Tesseract.js, loaded on demand from a CDN. Your PDF is rendered and recognized locally — never uploaded. Scanned/image PDFs only; text-based PDFs don't need OCR.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a scanned/image PDF.
  2. Pick the OCR language.
  3. Click "Run OCR" and wait while each page is recognized.
  4. Copy text per page or download everything as a .txt file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does this need the internet?

Tesseract.js is loaded on demand from the jsDelivr CDN when you start OCR. If it can't load (offline/blocked), you'll get an honest error instead of a fake result.

How accurate is the OCR?

Clean, high-contrast scans at 150+ DPI work best. Handwriting, skewed pages and tiny fonts reduce accuracy.

Is my PDF uploaded?

Yes — rendering and recognition run entirely in your browser. The OCR engine loads from a CDN but your PDF is never uploaded anywhere.
